name: xoga713-var-accounting-table-load
description: Copies the legacy var_accounting_table_<bu> rows (27 tables, value_date from fromDate) into opera.var_accounting_table, the source of helper_var_future_view and helper_var_vanilla_view. Insert only. Six business units (alm, coc, cof, oad, odr, spc) have no legacy table in the DDL dump and are not loaded.
